blocks.heading: Five9 cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Five9 against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: 50 concurrent-seat minimum — not viable for small SMB phone buyers. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
